channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: Blithe Spirit: Theatre 98 (WED 10/28)
item.description: Thu to Sun through 11/1 · 7:30 PM Thu to Sat, 2:30 PM Sun | Theatre 98, Fairhope | from $20. Noël Coward's classic ghost comedy plays at Theatre 98, Fairhope's intimate community playhouse. The remaining shows run Thursday 10/29 to Sunday 11/1, which makes it an easy dressed-up date night.

item.title: Blue Angels Practice + Autographs (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesday 10/28 · gates 9:30 AM, practice ~10:30 AM, autographs after | National Naval Aviation Museum flight line | Free. The Blue Angels fly a Wednesday practice over the National Naval Aviation Museum's flight line at NAS Pensacola, and team members then visit the museum to answer questions and sign autographs. The flight-line gates open at 9:30 AM, the jets are scheduled up at about 10:30 AM, and the flight, the autographs and the museum are all free. This is the last practice on the museum's 2026 schedule. Base entry pauses once the museum lot is full, so plan to arrive early.

item.title: Free Open Mic Comedy at Talk to the Moon Comedy Club (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesdays and Thursdays · start time not posted | Talk to the Moon Comedy Club | Free. Talk to the Moon Comedy Club sits in the back of Mathieson Brewing Company and runs free open mic comedy shows on Wednesdays and Thursdays. Comedians use the stage to test new material in front of a live audience. The club's page does not post start times, so check its site or call before driving.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (WED 10/28)
item.description: During library hours through 11/1 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. It hangs all day during the library's own hours through November 1, so call the library to confirm them before you go.

item.title: Make Your Own Glass (hot glass, by appointment) (WED 10/28)
item.description: By appointment: Wednesdays 5 PM-9 PM, Saturdays 8 AM-11 AM | First City Art Center | from $85. Make Your Own Glass is a hands-on hot glass session at First City Art Center in Pensacola, where each participant makes a piece with a glassblower. It's for ages 8 and up including adults, by appointment on Wednesdays from 5-9 PM and Saturdays from 8-11 AM. The finished piece cools in an annealing oven and is picked up the following week. Standard pieces cost $85, and premium pieces such as a pumpkin, ornament, cup or bowl cost $110-$140.

item.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile (WED 10/28)
item.description: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027 | History Museum of Mobile | from $8. The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

item.title: Murder at the Monster's Ball: Dinner Mystery (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesday 10/28 · doors 5:30 PM · show 6:00 PM | Historic Pensacola Village, Barkley House | from $65. Historic Pensacola turns the Barkley House into a monster party where a famous monster hunter crashes the guest list and the diners have to find the killer. ICMT Murder Mystery Theatre performs the show, and the ticket covers a themed dinner, beer and wine. Guests are invited to dress as a classic monster for a costume contest. The evening supports the UWF Historic Trust and is for guests 21 and older.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (WED 10/28)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Yoga: Friday and Wednesday beach classes (WED 10/28)
item.description: Fridays 9 AM and Wednesdays 6 PM | Pensacola Beach Yoga, beside the Gulf Pier | from $10. Pensacola Beach Yoga runs drop-in yoga on the sand beside the Gulf Pier at 41 Fort Pickens Road in Pensacola Beach. Classes are Fridays at 9 AM and Wednesdays at 6 PM, and they cost $10 with no registration. Bring a mat or towel.

item.title: Pensacola Interstate Fair (WED 10/28)
item.description: Oct 22 to Nov 1 | Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds | from $7.24. Eleven days of rides, livestock barns and fried everything at the fairgrounds off Mobile Highway. Gate admission is $16.06 for adults and $7.24 for children 4 to 11, and children 3 and under are free.

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (WED 10/28)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center (WED 10/28)
item.description: Oct 17 to Oct 30 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions from October through April. The first sessions in this window run Saturday 10/17 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/18 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Saturday 10/24 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/25 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Friday 10/30 at 9:30 PM. Capacity is limited for each session, so buy tickets early.

item.title: Smartphone Photography Workshop: Photographing People at Ski Beach (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesday 10/28 · time not published | Ski Beach, NAS Pensacola | No published price. Navy MWR leads a walking tour at Ski Beach that teaches smartphone photography of people. The events page lists tips on lighting, framing and capturing genuine expressions along scenic local spots. A second workshop on posing people follows on November 25.

item.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street (WED 10/28)
item.description: Fri 10/23 to Sun 11/1 · Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:30 PM | Pensacola State College, Ashmore Auditorium, Building 8 | from $7. Pensacola State College stages Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street in Ashmore Auditorium over two weekends, October 23 to 25 and October 30 to November 1. The college describes the eight-time Tony Award winning musical as a thriller about an exiled barber who seeks revenge on a corrupt system of justice. One performance falls on Halloween night.

item.title: The View Within exhibition at Blue Morning Gallery (WED 10/28)
item.description: Sunday 10/25 to Saturday 11/28 · reception Friday 11/6 at 4:30 | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Blue Morning Gallery in downtown Pensacola shows The View Within, an exhibition of colorful abstract paintings by the featured artist, from October 25 through November 28. A reception on Friday November 6 at 4:30 lets visitors meet the artist, hear live music and enjoy refreshments and conversation.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (WED 10/28)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (WED 10/28)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Shape & Sculpt Fitness Class (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesdays · 8:15 AM to 9:15 AM | Destin Community Center | from $5. Shape & Sculpt is a light-weight fitness class set to music at the Destin Community Center, built around muscle strength, balance and core work. The city says it's open to all ages and fitness levels, and it runs every Wednesday morning. Each class costs $5.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (WED 10/28)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (WED 10/28)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (WED 10/28)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (WED 10/28)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Zumba Gold: Wednesday (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesdays · 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. This Wednesday session of Zumba Gold is a low-impact class built around routines that are easy to follow. It asks a $3 donation and runs early, from 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM, at the Niceville Senior Center. It repeats weekly and is aimed at the center's members age 55 and up.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (WED 10/28)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Fall Into Family History at Santa Rosa County Libraries (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesdays, a different library each week (Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze, Navarre) · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Santa Rosa County libraries: Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze and Navarre | No published price. The library system's lead reference specialist visits one branch each Wednesday in October to help people start or extend a family tree. Visitors can bring a specific research question or simply stop by to learn how to get started with the library's genealogy resources. The help runs during regular library hours, so no appointment time is listed.

item.title: IMC Book Fair at the University of South Alabama (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesday 10/28 · 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Humanities Courtyard, University of South Alabama | No published price. The Independent Music Collective holds its final book fair of the semester in the Humanities Courtyard at the University of South Alabama on Wednesday, October 28, from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Tables carry used books on all topics, music in a variety of formats and wall art. Donations support the IMC Concert Series, and the fair moves only if the weather allows it to be held in the courtyard.

item.title: Veterans Chat 'n Chew (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesdays · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Veterans gather at the Niceville Senior Center for an hour of casual conversation about the present and the past. The city describes it simply as a chance to get together with other veterans who share the experience. Access follows the center's usual membership rules, so residents attend free and others pay the standard day rate.

item.title: Beginner Line Dance: Wednesday (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesdays · 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This beginner line dance class teaches simple steps for members new to the form. Because the sessions run crowded, the city asks participants to pick either the Wednesday or the Friday class rather than attending both. It meets from 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM at the Niceville Senior Center and repeats weekly through October.

item.title: Music and Me at the Valparaiso Library (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesday 10/28 · 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM | Valparaiso Library | No published price. Music and Me is a half hour class at the Valparaiso Library that introduces children to musical concepts and movement through interactive play with Mrs. Hillary. It meets Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 9:30 AM, and Wednesdays welcome all ages. Mondays are for ages 0 to 5 and Fridays are for ages 0 to 3.

item.title: Ping Pong Meet-Up (WED 10/28)
item.description: 9:30 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This ping pong meetup at the Niceville Senior Center is open to beginners and experienced players alike, and the city says no experience is required to join in. It runs Wednesday mid morning and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: Ages 3 to 5 Storytime Class at Crestview Library (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesdays or Thursdays · 10:00 AM | Crestview Library: Story Room | No published price. Crestview Library holds a weekly storytime class for preschoolers, with families choosing either the Wednesday or the Thursday session at 10:00 AM. Each class has stories, music, movement and a craft around a theme, such as Silly on October 14 or 15 and Farm Fun on October 21 or 22. Younger siblings and older children are welcome.

item.title: Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home at the Mobile Museum of Art (WED 10/28)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 1/9 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Aminah Robinson: Journeys Home is a special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art that draws on the artist's historical research, folklore and personal narrative. The museum describes it as a visual memoir of her life and a tableau of the African American experience. It stays open through January 9, 2027.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (WED 10/28)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Gateway: From Graffiti to Gallery at the Mobile Museum of Art (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, through 9/1/2027 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. The Mobile Museum of Art traces how artists who started with graffiti in New York's subways moved into galleries, with work by Basquiat, Haring, Scharf, KAWS and Banksy from the Masterworks Foundation collection. The show runs a full year, Wednesday through Saturday. Mobile County residents get in free on Thursdays.

item.title: Good Listener Storytime at Moorer (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesdays · 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. Young children gather at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library for stories, songs and early literacy activities in this half-hour storytime. It is also offered again on Wednesdays, including October 7 and October 14.

item.title: Halloween Hike at the Destin Library (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesday 10/28 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Destin Library | No published price. Destin Library invites preschoolers and their families to trick or treat through stations of goodies on the library's front lawn on Wednesday morning. The Friends Guild of the Destin Library sponsors the event, and registration is open on the library's calendar until it starts.

item.title: Handle with Care at the Mobile Museum of Art (WED 10/28)
item.description: Tuesday to Saturday · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · through 3/27 | Mobile Museum of Art | from $8. Handle with Care is an interactive special exhibition at the Mobile Museum of Art. Artists Calder Kamin of Austin and Jacob Reptile of New Orleans turn trash into soft, complex sculptures that visitors move through as an environment. It stays open through March 27, 2027.

item.title: Haunted Courtyard at Baytowne Wharf (WED 10/28)
item.description: Daily through Saturday 10/31 · 10:00 AM to 9:30 PM | Village of Baytowne Wharf, Tupelo Courtyard | Free. The Village of Baytowne Wharf turns Tupelo Courtyard into a haunted walk-through for the month of October. It is free to enter and open from 10 AM to 9:30 PM, so it fits a daytime stroll with small kids or a dusk visit before dinner. The courtyard sits between Cloak and Dagger and Paradise Found, beside Bunkley's.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (WED 10/28)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free.

item.title: Meet! Play! Learn! (Gulf Breeze) (WED 10/28)
item.description: Wednesday 10/28 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Gulf Breeze Library | No published price. Meet, Play, Learn turns the Gulf Breeze Library into a circuit of hands-on stations for children not yet in kindergarten. A caregiver works each station alongside the child, since it runs as free play rather than a sit-and-listen story time. The county calendar lists only the time and place, with no published price or age cutoff.
